metadata.description: Top 100 longest performance streaks in high school football history. A streak is a consecutive sequence of games where the team's Game Performance score stayed at or above 22.04 — the minimum recorded during De La Salle (Concord CA)'s record 151-game winning streak (1992-2004). Game Performance = Average of both teams Combined Rating + (Team Margin / 2). Unrated opponents use a rating of 0. Minimum 20 qualifying games required.
